title: Fourth moment bound for a product average
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $g,h$ be real-valued functions on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose that $g(x)^3=g(x)$ and $g(x)^4=g(x)^2$ for every point $x$. Then $(\mathbb E[gh])^4\le(\mathbb E[g^2])^3\mathbb E[h^4]$, where the expectations are uniform averages over the cube.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued functions $g,h$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
